scope.classification_rule: bucket is the effective side_effects declaration governing the put: literal put keyword > enclosing class declaration > caller-resolved declaration for module-level helpers. Only pure_declared (side_effects is False) is admitted by the typed default; True and undeclared are refused (undeclared fails closed).

method.file_discovery: os.walk over the three roots, sorted
method.constructors: Call whose callee resolves to a store class name
method.put_sites: Call with Attribute(attr='put') whose receiver type is inferred from (i) a constructor call, (ii) self.<attr> = <store>(...), (iii) an annotated parameter whose class assigns .cache, (iv) a local assignment whose RHS is a store constructor or a method returning one, or (v) method-usage inference for unannotated parameters
method.side_effects: class-body attribute, self.side_effects assignment, or super().__init__(side_effects=...) in the class's own __init__; an explicit declaration on a local ancestor is inherited; a bare constructor default is recorded as undeclared (legacy default True)
method.helper_puts: a put inside a module-level helper is resolved to the factory calls / callers that pass side_effects=<literal>; unresolved or conflicting callers stay undeclared
method.tenant_reach: execute signature argument containing 'tenant', a class-level tenant attribute, a current_tenant/tenant_scope reference, else nothing; precedence argument > contextvar > class_attribute
method.determinism: sorted files and sites, no timestamps or wall-clock values

pure_declared.meaning: side_effects is False; the typed default admits

effectful_declared.meaning: side_effects is True; the typed default refuses (legacy put stored it unconditionally)

undeclared.meaning: no declaration; the legacy default is True, so the typed default refuses (fail closed)

notes: Reconciliation with gap report section 1: it states 96 execute(input_params) implementations in agentflow/. This AST pass finds 96 execute definitions under agentflow/core, 104 under agentflow/ and 144 repo-wide; 44 have the (self, input_params) signature.

The (c) cohort is every execute definition whose class transitively holds a result store: 45 definitions (44 with an InstructionCache/SoundResultCache and 1 with ObjectiveDecompositionInstruction's DecompositionCache).
Every .put call in the three roots is attributed: 16 total = 15 on the two in-scope stores + 1 on DecompositionCache.
A put inside a module-level helper is resolved through the factory calls that receive the helper; each such site carries the resolving file:line in resolution.evidence.
All numbers are recomputed from the tree on every run; no value is copied from a report or artifact. The file contains no timestamps, absolute paths or wall-clock values.
caveats: admitted_under_typed_default applies the effect gate exactly as specified (only side_effects is False admits). SoundResultCache also refuses an identity-dependent put with no tenant and a put with footprint=None; the tenant and footprint blocks report those readiness gaps separately instead of folding them into the buckets.
8 of the admitted sites have no tenant channel in lexical scope. They pass the effect gate but would need tenant_scope(...) or identity_dependent=False to be admitted by the typed store.
Effectful_declared contains one intentional already-typed probe (shipped_sound_cache_replay.py:411) that the class refuses; only the flip-cohort effectful sites are legacy memoisation bugs.

CompositeInstruction's effectful declaration is conditional (True when the caller passes no side_effects argument, overridable per instance).  Its unconditional legacy put at instruction.py:537 is the memoisation bug only under that default; a caller that passes side_effects=False is pure.
benchmark-local policy helpers (cache_identity.remember / invalidate) operate on caller-owned dictionaries and are not store constructors; they are not part of this census.
The pass is static: it counts lexical construction/put sites and cannot see stores created dynamically (getattr, exec, factories that return a cache object).
